entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 1. Heard the learned Advocate for the Applicant and the learned APP for the State on the point of interim protection.
2. The Informant, who is the Food Safety Officer got the information regarding the transportation of banned gutkha and tobacco from the State of Madhya Pradesh.
A trap was laid, and the vehicle was intercepted.
The articles worth Rs. 8,16,000/- came to be seized from the said vehicle on the border of Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh.
The Applicant was present in the said vehicle but he managed to escape.

The incident was reported to the Police, and Crime bearing No. 0175 of 2025 came to be registered with Muktainagar Police Station, District Jalgaon,
for offences punishable under Sections 26(2)(iv), 59, 27(3)(d),
 2 915ABA1708.2025.odt 27(3)(e), 3 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, and Sections Santosh Alias Bablu Pralhad Koli vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another on 30 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142716964/
1 123, 223, 274 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, against the Applicant.
3.

sentences.text: The only non-bailable Section is 123 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.
Prima facie, there is no allegation of administering the banned articles.
The person who sold the said articles has already been protected by this Court vide order dated 22 nd July, 2025 passed in Anticipatory Bail Application No. 1154 of 2025.

Hence, I pass the following interim order : -
 ORDER [i] Issue notice to the Respondents, returnable on 14th October, 2025.
Learned APP waives service of notice for the State.

[ii] In the event of arrest of the Applicant, Santosh @ Bablu Pralhad Koli, in connection with Crime bearing No. 0175 of 2025 came to be registered with Muktainagar Police Station, District Jalgaon, for offences punishable under Sections 26(2)(iv), 59, 27(3)(d), 27(3)(e), 3 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Sections 123, 223, 274 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, he be released on bail on his furnishing P.B. of Rs. 15,000/- [Rupees Fifteen Thousand], with one surety in the like amount.
3 915ABA1708.2025.odt [iii] The Applicant shall attend Muktainagar Police Station, District Jalgaon, on every Thursday in between 12:00 pm to 04:00 pm.
He is further directed to co-operate with the Investigating Agency.

[iv] The Applicant shall furnish detailed residential address and contact number to the Investigating Officer, and shall not change the same without informing the concerned Police Station.
[v] The Applicant shall not leave the State of Maharashtra without the permission of this Court.
[NEERAJ P. DHOTE] JUDGE SG Punde Signed by: Sandeep Gulabrao Punde Designation: PS To Honourable Judge Date: 30/09/2025 17:50:30 Santosh Alias Bablu Pralhad Koli vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another on 30 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/142716964/
